Overview

Applied AI & GenAI for AgriFinance & Commodity Markets earns its budget only when it changes a number on someone's scorecard. So we invert the usual sequence: lock the metric and its baseline first, then work backwards to the smallest architecture that moves it — usually composed from farm management systems and the tower platform rather than built from scratch. In Agriculture & Food Systems the constraints are structural, not cosmetic: EU deforestation rules shapes what data may move, yield per hectare dominates the economics, and any capability that cannot explain its own decisions will be switched off by risk committees. The architecture reflects all three from the first commit.
